name: form_heading
label: Form Heading
help_text: Sits directly above the form. Keep it to 3-5 words.

name: form_subhead
label: Form Subhead
default: Fill out the form and our team reaches out within one business day.
help_text: One line. Sets the expectation for what happens after they submit.

name: form_guid
label: HubSpot Form GUID
help_text: Default is the Contact form that produced the existing deals. Only change this if you deliberately want a different form.

name: expect_body
label: What To Expect — Body
default: A 15-minute discovery call where we learn about your dealership, show you the platform, and discuss how MDD solves your specific challenges. No hard sell. Just answers.
help_text: Describe exactly what the dealer gets. On the free-offer pages, spell out the deliverable.
